headings.reviewNote: Requires establishing an electronic funds transfer system for direct deposit, authorizes electronic access cards for non-direct-deposit obligees, and permits persons or employers to pay by check or draft without penalty.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.530 governing Family Support Payment Center establishment, operations, disbursement deadlines, and electronic transfers.

headings.title: Debt and administrative or setoff recovery of erroneous payments
headings.reviewNote: Establishes recipient indebtedness for child support erroneously paid through no fault of the division and authorizes administrative/legal collection or setoff from support moneys, excluding current monthly support.

headings.title: Crime of stealing for retaining erroneously paid support
headings.reviewNote: Makes knowingly retaining possession of child support erroneously paid through no fault of the division after reimbursement is requested, with purpose to deprive without consent or by deceit or coercion, the crime of stealing under section 570.030.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 454.531 governing recovery and setoff of erroneously paid child support and criminal stealing penalties for knowing retention.

headings.title: Establishment of Family Support Trust Fund
headings.reviewNote: Creates the Family Support Trust Fund in the state treasury with interest earnings credited to general revenue.

headings.title: Non-state fund status and commingling prohibition
headings.reviewNote: Designates trust fund moneys as non-state custodial funds and prohibits commingling with state general revenues.

headings.title: Maintenance and inspection of trust fund records
headings.reviewNote: Requires accurate accounting records of trust fund receipts and disbursements open to inspection by authorized parties.

headings.title: Refunds to trust fund for erroneous payments to state
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director or division to authorize the state treasurer to make refunds to the trust fund for erroneous payments and overpayments to the state.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.533 governing the Family Support Trust Fund, non-state fund status, recordkeeping, and refunds.

headings.title: Maintenance of records in automated child support system
headings.reviewNote: Directs the division to maintain automated child support system records of payment center receipts and disbursements, current and past-due amounts, and historical circuit clerk records.

headings.title: Circuit clerk certification of historical payment records
headings.reviewNote: Requires circuit clerks to certify past payment records upon redirection (deeming automated system records certified) and directs the division or clerk to record specified other credits including abatements, in-kind payments, tax refunds, and garnishment actions.

headings.title: Recording payments and address changes in non-IV-D cases
headings.reviewNote: Limits division recording in non-IV-D cases to payment center receipts while clerks record other credits, permits division address updates, and requires parties to notify the payment center of name or address changes (sufficient for section 454.413).

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 454.536 governing automated payment records, circuit clerk certifications, credits, and non-IV-D procedures; source note records original-rolls word discrepancy ('garnishments') in subsection 2.

headings.title: Admissibility of certified payment center records in evidence
headings.reviewNote: Makes certified copies of payment center, automated system, or circuit clerk payment and disbursement records (including electronic or optically scanned copies) admissible without further proof or foundation.

headings.title: Certification of payment records without additional signature proof
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes certification by the director, circuit clerk or designee, or payment center employee without extrinsic proof of official character or signature, regardless of who made the entry, establishing prima facie evidence of support paid.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.539 governing legal admissibility of payment center records and official certification requirements.

headings.title: Rebuttable presumption for electronically transmitted court orders
headings.reviewNote: Establishes a rebuttable presumption of accuracy for court orders and filed court documents transmitted by facsimile or other electronic means to the division, admissible without authentication in chapter 454 proceedings.

headings.title: Rebuttal of presumption using certified court copies
headings.reviewNote: Allows contesting authenticity by rebutting the presumption with a certified copy, and requires the clerk to furnish certified copies to the division upon request without charge.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.545 governing rebuttable presumptions of authenticity for transmitted judicial orders and documents.

headings.title: Authority to require certified or guaranteed checks
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the division upon notice to require an obligor to pay by certified or guaranteed check, while exempting non-payor check originators unless an insufficient funds check is received and section procedures are followed.

headings.title: Processing fee for insufficient funds checks
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the payment center (with division authorization) or state to charge up to twenty-five dollars for processing an insufficient funds check, require future certified/guaranteed checks, and collect the fee as a support order.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.551 governing certified check mandates and processing fees for insufficient funds checks.

headings.title: Circumstances barring recording of current support obligations
headings.reviewNote: Bars recording a current support obligation in the automated system when the division determines current support under section 454.465 or 454.470 is no longer due (with first-class notice and a thirty-day hearing right), when an issuing court terminates its order, or when terminated under section 452.340.11(1)-(4).

headings.title: Preservation of enforceable past-due child support debts
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that excluding current support from automated records does not affect or extinguish accrued unpaid past support.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.557 governing exclusions from automated recording and preservation of unpaid past-due support.

headings.title: Judicial and administrative authority to order health coverage
headings.reviewNote: Directs courts and the division to determine whether to require health benefit plan coverage in support proceedings.

headings.title: Mandatory health plan requirement in IV-D cases
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes requiring accessible health benefit plan coverage (mandatory in IV-D cases), mandates private employer or union coverage when available at reasonable cost, and lists four factors courts must consider when private coverage is unavailable at reasonable cost.

headings.title: Required terms and policy limits of health plans
headings.reviewNote: Permits orders to specify available plan terms including minimum policy limits, minimum coverage, maximum deductibles or co-payments, and ERISA of 1974 provisions.

headings.title: Parental priority when health benefit plans are available
headings.reviewNote: Requires ordering private health plan coverage available to one parent at reasonable cost unless the other parent has comparable or better coverage at comparable or reduced cost, and directs selecting between comparable plans available to both parents.

headings.title: Obligor liability for uncovered medical and dental expenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires making the obligor liable for all or part of uncovered medical or dental expenses if the court finds coverage does not pay all reasonable and necessary expenses, the obligor has financial resources, and the obligee substantially complied with plan terms.

headings.title: Health insurance premiums considered in support calculation
headings.reviewNote: Provides that employee insurance contributions are not direct offsets to support awards but factor into calculations.

headings.title: Coordination of complementary or primary and secondary plans
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes ordering each parent to maintain complementary health benefit plans providing primary and secondary coverage.

headings.title: Best interest considerations before altering health plans
headings.reviewNote: Requires courts and the division, before terminating or changing a health benefit plan, to consider the child's medical condition, best interests, and whether a new plan would omit or limit benefits for a preexisting condition.

headings.title: Independent health care obligation unaffected by support abatement
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that child support abatements do not automatically abate a parent's independent duty to provide health coverage.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.603 governing health benefit plan mandates, accessible coverage, terms, uninsured expenses, and offsets.

headings.title: Notice to employer or union regarding health coverage
headings.reviewNote: Requires the circuit clerk or division in IV-D income-withholding cases, and the division when enforcing health coverage orders, to send notice to the obligated parent's employer or union.

headings.title: Delivery methods by regular or certified mail
headings.reviewNote: Requires sending the notice to the employer or union by regular mail or by certified mail, return receipt requested.

headings.title: Mandatory use of National Medical Support Notice
headings.reviewNote: Requires the division to use the federal National Medical Support Notice (mandating compliance for Missouri and regular out-of-state IV-D notices), transfer it within two business days of new-hire directory entry, and promptly notify employers when orders end.

headings.title: Minimum required contents of circuit clerk notice
headings.reviewNote: Specifies minimum notice items including parent identification, dependent names, and coverage mandate statements.

headings.title: Notice binding on current and successor employers
headings.reviewNote: Establishes notices to withhold premium contributions as binding on current and successor employers.

headings.title: No stay of premium withholding pending section 454.609 hearing
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits holding health benefit plan employee contribution or premium withholding in abeyance pending the outcome of any hearing under section 454.609.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 454.606 governing employer/union health coverage notices, National Medical Support Notices, required clerk notice contents, binding effect, and non-abeyance pending hearings.

headings.title: Notice to obligor of medical child support withholding
headings.reviewNote: Requires sending notice to the obligor by mail concurrently with notices sent to employers or unions.

headings.title: Exclusive grounds to contest medical support withholding
headings.reviewNote: Limits grounds for contesting medical support withholding to mistake of fact (defined as an error in obligor identity) or prior acquisition of comparable insurance.

headings.title: Administrative and court hearings on medical withholding contests
headings.reviewNote: Directs the court or director to hold a hearing, enter an order resolving disputed issues, and notify the obligated party within forty-five days of receiving the notice of contest.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.609 governing medical support notices to obligors, contest grounds, and hearing procedures.

headings.title: Thirty-day deadline for obligor proof of compliance
headings.reviewNote: Requires obligors in non-IV-D cases to provide written proof of compliance (coverage obtained or complete application made) to obligees within thirty days of receiving effective notice.

headings.title: Duty to forward order to employer or union
headings.reviewNote: Requires the obligee to forward a copy of the court order to the obligor's employer or union when court-ordered or after thirty-day noncompliance, mailed notice of intent, fifteen-day continued failure, and filing a clerk affidavit.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.612 governing non-IV-D proof of coverage compliance and forwarding orders to employers.

headings.title: Employer transfer of medical support order to plan
headings.reviewNote: Requires employers or unions to transfer health coverage orders or notices (excluding severable withholding notices) to the appropriate group health plan within twenty business days after the order or notice date.

headings.title: Plan administrator notice of coverage availability and terms
headings.reviewNote: Requires plan administrators, within forty business days after the order or notice date, to notify the issuing agency of coverage availability, status, effective date, or required steps, and to provide coverage descriptions and forms.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.615 governing employer transfer of orders to group health plans and administrator response deadlines.

headings.title: Employer duty to enroll child as eligible dependent
headings.reviewNote: Requires employers or unions to enroll the minor child, withhold and remit premiums, and follow plan-selection rules (obligor's plan, least costly plan for non-NMSN orders, or NMSN plan summaries with twenty-business-day agency selection or default enrollment).

headings.title: Division or custodial parent execution of enrollment forms
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the division, custodial parent, or guardian to provide required enrollment information and authorization if the obligor fails or refuses to execute enrollment documents.

headings.title: Validity of alternative enrollment and bar on out-of-wedlock exclusions
headings.reviewNote: Validates enrollment information and authorization provided by the division, custodial parent, or guardian, and declares plan provisions denying or restricting coverage due to birth out of wedlock void as against public policy.

headings.title: Duration of child dependency for health plan coverage
headings.reviewNote: Treats the minor child as a dependent for health coverage purposes until the child's right to parental support terminates or further court order, but never past the plan's limiting age.

entries.reviewSummary: Source-checked editorial subsection headings for section 454.618 governing dependent enrollment, plan option selection, alternative enrollment authorization, voiding out-of-wedlock exclusions, and dependency duration.

headings.title: Obligor liability for medical expenses upon coverage lapse
headings.reviewNote: Holds obligors who fail to maintain health coverage liable for resulting medical and dental costs and premiums.

headings.title: Lapse of coverage as grounds to increase support
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that failure to maintain health coverage demonstrates increased need supporting child support increases.

headings.title: Joint and several parental liability to medical providers
headings.reviewNote: Imposes joint and several parental liability to medical providers for necessary care, allows equitable apportionment of uncovered expenses between parents by income share or agreement, and defaults to fifty percent each if unspecified.

headings.title: Director action in court for medical expenses
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the director to initiate circuit court actions to recover obligors' share of unreimbursed medical expenses.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.633 governing liability for failure to maintain coverage, child support increases, and medical expense actions.

headings.title: Priority of health plan withholding over other processes
headings.reviewNote: Establishes health coverage withholding priority over all other legal processes except current child support withholding.

headings.title: CCPA classification and exclusion when withholding caps exceeded
headings.reviewNote: Treats health coverage withholding as current child support for CCPA 15 U.S.C. 1673(b) limits and concurrent operation, but prohibits including it in pro rata distribution or withholding any health premium amount when concurrent withholdings exceed caps.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.636 governing income withholding priority for health benefit plans and treatment as current support.

headings.title: Employer discharge of liability upon order compliance
headings.reviewNote: Discharges employers and unions from liability to obligors for earnings withheld in compliance with medical orders.

headings.title: Termination of medical support order for good cause
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the court or director, upon the obligor's motion and for good cause shown, to terminate the respective judicial or administrative health benefit plan coverage order.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.642 governing employer discharge of liability upon compliance and termination of medical support orders.

headings.title: Prohibition against employee discharge or retaliation
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits discharging, disciplining, or refusing to hire an employee due to a sections 454.600 to 454.645 order or notice, with a thirty-day rebuttable presumption overcome only by clear, cogent, and convincing evidence.

headings.title: Civil contempt proceedings for employer retaliation
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes an aggrieved obligor to bring a civil contempt motion in the underlying action and authorizes the director to bring a circuit court action for wrongful discharge or discipline.

headings.title: Remedies and penalties for unlawful employer action
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes reinstatement, hiring, rescinding discipline, and judgment for back wages, costs, attorney's fees, premiums, and child support, plus fines up to five hundred dollars after notice and hearing for noncompliance.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.645 governing protections against employer retaliation, civil contempt remedies, and penalties.

headings.title: Insurer enrollment obligations under court or administrative orders
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers (including ERISA 607(1) group health plans) issuing or renewing policies on or after July 1, 1994, to allow enrollment without season restrictions, accept enrollment by the other parent, FSD, MO HealthNet, or another state's tribunal, and restrict disenrollment to four specified conditions.

headings.title: Employer and union duties to enroll children and restrict disenrollment
headings.reviewNote: Requires Missouri employers and unions to permit family enrollment without season restrictions, enroll children upon application by the other parent, FSD, MO HealthNet, or another state's tribunal, and bar disenrollment except under three specified conditions.

headings.title: Prohibition of discriminatory insurer requirements against state
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits insurers from imposing different requirements on state agencies assigned medical assistance rights.

headings.title: Insurer duty to provide information and accept claims
headings.reviewNote: Requires insurers covering a child through a noncustodial parent to provide benefit information to the custodial parent or guardian, accept claims without noncustodial approval, and pay directly to the parent, provider, or MO HealthNet division.

headings.title: MO HealthNet division garnishment and tax refund withholding
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes the MO HealthNet division to garnish employment income and withhold state tax refunds under section 143.783 when a parent ordered to cover a Medicaid-eligible child retains third-party payments without reimbursing, subordinate to current or past-due child support claims.

headings.title: Cumulative nature of medical support enforcement remedies
headings.reviewNote: Establishes that medical support collection and enforcement remedies under this section are cumulative to other legal remedies and apply regardless of when the order was entered.

entries.reviewSummary: Adds editorial subsection headings for section 454.700 governing insurer enrollment mandates, employer compliance, income garnishment, and supplemental remedies.
